subject: SLO derogation request and evidence bundle for checkout latency blip
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@cartwheel.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: payments.ops@cartwheel.com
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:09:12 -0400
Subject: sudden checkout latency spike — impacted checkout success rate

Hi Olga,

We saw a sharp increase in checkout latency between ~09:45–10:10 UTC this morning and a bunch of requests timed out on our side (5xx / 30s). Our engineering team pulled traces and we can share logs if useful. Cartwheel is in the middle of a holiday promo and this spike caused a measurable drop in conversion.

Can you confirm whether this incident is within Redwood's SLO window for availability/latency, and what the compensation path looks like if it qualifies? We need an estimate ASAP to brief our Ops and finance.

Thanks,
Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Payments Engineering
Cartwheel Commerce

(attachment: cartwheel-checkout-logs-20280822.zip (zip, 14.2MB))

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@cartwheel.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:28:41 -0400
Subject: Re: sudden checkout latency spike — impacted checkout success rate

Hi Amy — thanks for the heads up and the logs. I'm escalating to our infra team to get a verified impact window and trace bundle.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- Rishi & Marcus to validate the availability/latency window against host-level metrics and our request traces.
- We'll provide a raw trace bundle (hop-by-hop), KV cache snapshots, and a timeline within 4 business hours.
- If the window meets SLA eligibility, we'll outline the credit calculation and a proposed remediation/postmortem timeline.

Please confirm the approximate loss in conversion (% or $) if you have it — it will help prioritization.

Olga
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 12:05:03 -0400
Subject: Re: sudden checkout latency spike — impacted checkout success rate

Olga — initial analysis attached.

Summary so far:
- Observed a tail-latency spike concentrated between 09:44:18–10:04:26 UTC (approx 1,268s total degraded time across affected shards).
- Root cause hypothesis: transient KV cache eviction storm triggered by a concurrent cluster autoscaler event in us-west-2; several kernels fell back to slower quantized path for ~18s at the hottest nodes.
- Evidence attached: redwood-traces-20280822-window.json (request-level traces), kvcache-snapshot-20280822.tar.gz (cache stats).

Preliminary verdict on SLO eligibility: not yet final — we need to reconcile the customer-requested request ids with our request logs to determine whether these were retriable errors or timeouts originating from the client. If they are server-side timeouts/5xx, they likely qualify for a credit review under our availability SLO.

I'll run the full reconciliation and push a final window + tokenized-request counts in the next 3 hours.

- Rishi
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redwood-traces-20280822-window.json, kvcache-snapshot-20280822.tar.gz)

From: Amy Chen <amy@cartwheel.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: payments.ops@cartwheel.com
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 14:01:09 -0400
Subject: Re: sudden checkout latency spike — impacted checkout success rate

Thanks — our analysts estimate a ~7% drop in successful checkouts during the 09:45–10:05 UTC window. Rough number is about $42k gross merchandise volume impacted. We attached request ids for a sample of failed requests.

Let us know when you have the reconciled counts. We would like a firm answer by end of day so we can decide whether to apply our temporary fallback.

— Amy

(attachment: sample_failed_request_ids.txt)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 09:12:17 -0700
Subject: Verified degraded window + proposed credit approach

Team — final reconciliation completed. Details: 
- Verified degraded window: 2028-08-22T09:44:18Z — 2028-08-22T10:04:26Z (UTC).
- Affected requests: 4,312 requests that returned 5xx or exceeded client-side 30s timeout within that window.
- Token charge calculation: 1,128,540 prompt+completion tokens billed in-window (per-model medians applied).

SLO eligibility notes:
- The majority of errors are server-side 5xx and correlate with host-level preemption/eviction events; as such this meets our availability incident criteria.
- Because part of the impact coincided with Cartwheel's retry/backoff behavior, we recommend a partial credit calculation that excludes client-initiated retries after 30s.

Proposed remedial action for Cartwheel: 
1) Credit: prorated credit equal to 75% of prorated services fees for the hour, applied to next billing cycle.
2) Postmortem: full incident report with RCA and remediations within 10 business days.
3) Preventative: a hotspot autoscaler tuning change + a safeguard to prevent simultaneous kernel fallback on the same allocation.

I've looped in Laura for billing approval. If approved, I'll draft the customer note and credit calculation table.

- Marcus
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

(attachment: impact_counts_olga_20280822.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Amy Chen <amy@cartwheel.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verified degraded window + proposed credit approach

Amy / Cartwheel team — thanks for the patience. We reviewed Marcus's reconciliation and approve the remedial package below: 

Approved remediation & commercial response: 
- Credit: 75% prorated credit applied to Redwood service charges corresponding to the verified window (one hour), to be applied to Cartwheel's next invoice.
- Postmortem: Redwood will deliver an RCA and a timeline of implemented mitigations within 10 business days.
- Follow-up: a 30-minute technical sync (optional) to walk through the RCA if Cartwheel requests.

Amy, I'll have billing produce the credit memo and confirm the invoice adjustment. Expect a confirmation email and the amount calculation by EOD tomorrow.

Olga — please attach the finalized impact CSV and the postmortem timeline to HB-102345.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Billing & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
